scientific_integrity: The statement follows from a complete structural decomposition and has been checked by independent direct graph enumeration on finitely many instances. No third-party certification or independent audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The complete polynomial is proved for three internally disjoint terminal paths of edge length at least two; no claim covers path length one, added chords or larger networks. Priority remains provisional, and finite checks are not substituted for the general combinatorial proof.
title: Exact connected zero-forcing polynomial of three-path theta graphs
